notes: Fuel canister: an amber jerrycan with a steel handle, a red cap, an embossed cross and a glowing gauge; rare. Drops fuel 1. Frames are the piece turned [-12, -4, 4, 12] degrees, lit from the top-left each time; loop them pingpong (`wrap` = 1,2,3,4,1... ; `pingpong` = 1,2,3,4,3,2,...), the game may also rotate the node. Glow layer: additive, pulsing a little per frame.
